object.title: UU-AAP Core v0.1 Receipt Chain Validator
object.description: Candidate Russian software-registration object: the standalone Node.js validator for machine-readable UU-AAP Core v0.1 receipt chains, with its receipt-envelope schema and conformance fixture as identifying/deposit-support material. Abstract protocol ideas, CCRP, KONTUR, PoAI and unrelated implementations are outside this Wave 1 software object.

unresolved_items: Identify the natural-person creative author(s) and contribution scopes for the selected Wave 1 surface.
Classify AI assistance/generated material and human creative selection/editing/integration evidence.
Determine the exclusive-right basis, including employment, commissioning and assignment boundaries.
Confirm whether any coauthor/contributor owns copyright-relevant expression in the selected deposit surface.
Complete third-party/material-origin clearance for validate-core.js, the receipt schema and the conformance fixture.
Resolve the separate patent/public-disclosure screen for this already-public Core surface.
Freeze the rights-cleared deposit package and compute its SHA-256 digest.

patentability.notes: Wave 1 is a software-registration candidate. The selected Core surface is already public; any patent claim over a separate technical solution requires a separate novelty/public-disclosure review and is not implied by this software filing.

registration_intent.rationale: Create an official registry record for one coherent, rights-cleared executable UU-AAP Core validator while preserving the distinction between protected software expression and abstract architecture or independently implemented protocol ideas.
